scope: Future evaluation runs prepared with a concurrency-capable execution engine
selection_basis: User-selected default following the 140-request live concurrency benchmark; four workers were fastest in both passes
implementation_requirements: Bound concurrent judge requests to four
Use isolated metric and judge state per task
Serialize immediate per-metric checkpoint commits and prevent duplicate tasks
Preserve existing timeouts, bounded retries and shared rate-limit/authentication stop handling
Record the actual concurrency in each new immutable experiment manifest
